steps.title: The documentation browser
steps.text: The tree on the left is the whole manual: concepts (what a method measures), guides (which tool, which settings) and the plugin reference. The page you pick opens on the right.

steps.title: Type an address or a search
steps.text: Enter a page such as docs/concepts/fcs.md, a citation key, a web address, or just words to search for.

await.hint: Type something into the address field.

steps.title: Go
steps.text: Go (or Enter) opens the page, or searches the documentation for your words.

steps.title: Back to the start
steps.text: Home shows the start page with the shortest ways in.

steps.title: Make the text larger
steps.text: A+ and A− change the reading size; Ctrl/Cmd and the mouse wheel do the same.
